normalization: ZhITNNormalizer then OpenCC t2s, NFKC, casefold, remove Unicode P/Z/C; clipped canonical mention counts use non-overlapping str.count; CER character Levenshtein.
test_tuning: test split only scored with dev selection values; no test parameter selection performed.
control_qwen: Qwen primary is scored when present; any genuinely missing hypothesis remains NA and is excluded from that arm sample denominator.
metric_denominators: sample counts are scored non-missing hypotheses; entity recall denominator is summed gold mentions; CER denominator is summed normalized reference characters.
limitations: Dataset is source-group separated dev/test; reports are specific to these model backends and this corpus.
Native CJK character-only dictionary encoding can cover only part of the all-canonical library; encoded and requested coverage are reported from native outputs.
Non-reference library canonical occurrences and incremental additions are lexical audit candidates only, not human-reviewed precision.

First match means the canonical appears in two consecutive available partials; the field records the first partial audio-available position. There is no gold acoustic entity-end time, so this is not entity-speech-end-to-caption latency.

Hybrid sequential compute is a compute estimate from CTC plus fusion plus saved Qwen primary HTTP wall where available; it is not measured concurrent end-to-end latency and is not comparable to native CPU wall time.
fresh_latency: Complete 8 fixed test inputs x4 arms, 32 paced actual streams; see PACED_PROFILE.md and paced_profile_summary.json. Final fusion included.
